Effective Fall 2027, qualified students who have fulfilled AUC’s admission requirements may apply to declare their major at the time of admission. Selection is competitive and will be based on an evaluation of:

  • High school grades
  • Focus Aptitude Test score (ASSESS or ITB Business)

  • Interview
